mechanism_narrative: A declining federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC for FEDFUNDS predicting 20-day returns remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or correlation with returns is not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in unemployment rate below 3.5% indicates labor market tightness that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 5-day returns in >60% of instances when UNRATE < 3.5, or average return not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: The joint decline in federal funds rate and unemployment rate signals coordinated monetary easing and labor market strength, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Interaction term (FEDFUNDS * UNRATE) has Rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-year window, or interaction effect not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS > 2.5%), rising interest rates compress equity valuations through higher discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in >60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 2.5, or average return not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) indicates expanding labor market capacity that supports consumer spending and corporate revenue growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC for PAYEMS predicting 5-day returns remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or correlation with returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) exceed 1250 thousand units, it signals strong consumer confidence and economic momentum, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in >60% of instances when HOUST > 1250, or average return not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: The joint increase in housing starts (HOUST) and industrial production (INDPRO) indicates synchronized demand and supply expansion, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Interaction term (HOUST * INDPRO) has Rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-year window, or interaction effect not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: During supply-side expansion (INDPRO > 110), increased industrial output boosts corporate earnings growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 5-day returns in >60% of instances when INDPRO > 110, or average return not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).
